subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 new third-party executable revisions in workflows that handle tokens, publishing credentials, security scans, write access, and agent API keys?
rationale: The pin replacements appear mechanically correct, but automated checks cannot decide whether maintainers accept the new trusted code at these privilege boundaries.

options.title: Accept after exact-head verification
options.body: Verify every upstream tag-to-SHA mapping and require the affected privileged workflows to pass on the final rebased head.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate setup-only actions from token, publishing, CodeQL, repository-management, and Codex revisions for narrower ownership review.

options.title: Defer the grouped refresh
options.body: Pause the PR if the combined supply-chain surface cannot receive owner review now.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head verification
recommendation.body: Verify every upstream tag-to-SHA mapping and require the affected privileged workflows to pass on the final rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow history and PR timeline most strongly connect this person to the cross-cutting CI, Docker, and agent-workflow decision.
